parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBProxyConnectString
parameters.description: The proxy endpoint that you want to query. You can call the DescribeDBProxy interface to query the proxy endpoint.

parameters.name: DBProxyEndpointId
parameters.description: The name of the proxy terminal. You can call the DescribeDBProxy interface to query the name of the proxy terminal.

parameters.name: DBProxyEngineType
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-db-proxy-endpoint --db-instance-id rm-bp1ja4f56s7us0000 --db-proxy-endpoint-id keaxncrjluwu0gue0000 --db-proxy-connect-string testproxy0000.rwlb.rds.aliyuncs.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-proxy-engine-type normal --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeDBProxyEndpoint --region cn-hangzhou --DBProxyConnectString 'testproxy0000.rwlb.rds.aliyuncs.com' --DBProxyEndpointId keaxncrjluwu0gue0000 --DBInstanceId 'rm-bp1ja4f56s7us0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DBProxyEngineType normal
